|game_text=Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each 'hit'. Permanent weapon is •[[Bossk's Mortar Gun]] (may target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit =0, if destiny matches target's destiny number).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V)]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB8-03-Bossk_With_Mortar_Gun-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V)]] (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); [[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of May 11, 2012"; this copy was re-made on 18 July 2012), page 2, slip 4 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each ‘hit.’ Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny = target's destiny number).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Bossk_With_Mortar_Gun.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-bosskwithmortargun-pre.gif]]) print it. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=5, page 5. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 ([[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V) (Errata 2)]]); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V) (Errata 3)]], the same words). The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) has “each 'hit'. Permanent” instead of “each ‘hit.’ Permanent”, “(may target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit =0, if destiny matches target's destiny number)” instead of “(may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny = target's destiny number)” (the pilot icon written out as “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots.”)<ref name="cl-1281_4-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each 'hit'. Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit =0, if destiny matches target's destiny number).” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-03-Bossk_With_Mortar_Gun-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 5)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V)]]) again, word for word: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each ‘hit.’ Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny = target's destiny number).” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later ([[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V) (Errata 3)]]) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-4-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-bosskwithmortargun-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V)]]) again, word for word: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each ‘hit.’ Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny = target's destiny number).” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
